text: This clip shows a customer paying an invoice by card.
The owner downloads the invoice as a PDF. It includes a pay-by-card link. They email it to the customer the way they do today, and mark it sent.
The customer opens the PDF, sees the balance due, and clicks pay by card.
A simple payment page takes their card. There is nothing to sign in to.
Back in the app, the invoice is marked paid and the balance is zero. The payment shows on the invoices list too.
